title: Pegasus@Dravidian-CodeMix-HASOC2021: Analyzing Social Media Content for Detection of Offensive Text
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of Transformer-based models (XLM-R and DistilBERT) for offensive language detection in Dravidian languages. While it briefly mentions religion as a target category of derogatory content in the introduction, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning as a component of the research.
